# Disclosure

A button that shows and hides the region right after it.

In `library/components/disclosure/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the trigger** — `type=button` `aria-expanded` `aria-controls`
- **the panel** — `aria-labelledby`

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — native: it is a <button>, so there is no key handler to write

**States:** expanded, collapsed

## Goes wrong when

- aria-expanded on the panel instead of the trigger — it is the control's state
- the panel hidden with height:0 or opacity, which hides it from nobody
- a div as the trigger, so there is no role and no keyboard
- aria-controls naming an id nobody built

**API:** `AC.createDisclosure(root, options) -> { open, close, toggle, isOpen, destroy }`

WCAG 1.3.1 2.1.1 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/) · see also `drawer`, `modal`, `tabs`
